concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-multibanco-ios-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15-captured iOS Drop-in guide for Sessions v68+ and Advanced voucher action, no extra method-specific request/configuration fields, and test offer-promotion/live request gates; source distinguishes pending voucher from paid sale.
warnings: Sessions states Checkout API v68+; do not transfer that minimum to Advanced without separate evidence.
No additional Multibanco fields does not mean no base integration request or SDK configuration.
Promote offer to sale is a test Customer Area simulation; a pending voucher is not payment completion.
